name: Incarnation of Chaos raises damage dealt by 15% for 15 seconds (#765)
contract: #765: Incarnation of Chaos 570067 reads '... In addition, your damage dealt is increased by $s3% for $d.' Effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79) with EffectMiscValue 127 (every school) and EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = 15; DurationIndex 8 is 15000 ms. Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone applies aura 79 natively, so a Chromatic Shard 801292 damage query rises by exactly 15% once the buff is up. This pins the clause that already works. The Chromatic Shard cooldown reset, cast-while-moving and free-next-cast clauses have no carrier in the record (effects 0 and 1 resolve to 0, and their masks do not select Chromatic Shard); docs/coa/chronomancer-completion.md records them and they are not asserted here.
